import { computed, state, type Readable, type State } from "@trioforge/crucible";
declare function plain(read: () => boolean): void;
declare function readable(read: Readable<boolean>): void;
declare function writable(value: State<boolean>): void;
declare function either(value: boolean | (() => boolean)): void;
const open = state(false);
const shown = computed(() => open());
plain(open); // fires
plain(() => open());
plain(shown);
readable(open);
writable(open);
either(open); // fires
const props: { open: () => boolean } = { open: open }; // fires
const wrapped: { open: Readable<boolean> } = { open };
open.set(!open());
export { props, wrapped };
